reviews.title: Screen not rotatable like other models. Image can be rotated in software though.
reviews.comment: Excellent value and quality! Screen size is huge! I will note that the screen on this model cannot be repositioned like their other models. It magnets on, but it has cutouts on the sides that have to line up with the cooling hoses. If you mount the cooler on the CPU with the hoses exiting towards the RAM, the screen and the logo on the edge of the screen surround will be vertical. That being said, the image can be rotated in the software so it was not an issue for me. I mounted mine with the hoses toward the RAM before I realized the screen only went on one way, I will probably rotate the CPU cooler to have the hoses exit to the bottom later on purely for aesthetics, but its fine as is. It operates fairly quietly, but the pump is audible when it kicks on. Not bothersome b/c once I start playing games my GPU fans kick up a notch and make it unnoticeable.
reviews.author: Branden Stark

reviews.title: Best AIO I've ever used. Biggest screen ever at 4in
reviews.comment: If you are trying to choose an AIO for your build this is the one. Don't get the Lian Li AIO. This one has a LOWER PRICE, the LARGEST SCREEN I've ever seen on an AIO (4in), WAY BETTER software to customize (use any font on your PC, Lian Li only lets you use their 7 fonts), and this cools my i9-14900 better than Lian Li (LL allowed my cpu to reach 100 degrees C, this one my cpu hasnt gone past 80 degrees doing the same tasks). After 6 months the lian li screen started glitching and they send you another screen you have to install yourself. This is the best AIO Ive ever used.
reviews.author: Ferrari Glenn

reviews.title: A great cooler with lots to offer for its price range!
reviews.comment: For the price it's hard to beat! The functionality of the screen allows you to utilize it as another display, so placing whatever you want on it is kinda nice. Easy to install and keeps the processor nice and cool. For its price, your getting what you payed for.
reviews.author: BrianH

reviews.title: Casi perfecta y vale la pena
reviews.comment: Le voy a dar un 4 aunque merece mas bien es 4.5 por varias razones: 1. El software que es muy tosco en ciertas formas, luego le coges el hilo y puedes controlar y poner tus creaciones a funcionar. Tiene un problema el software que cada vez que inicia windows tienes que darle a ACEPTAR a la notificacion para que el diseño se muestre en la pantalla. 2. La pasta termica es muy poquita, sirve solo para una aplicacion, asi que tienes que tener mucho cuidado y atencion antes de montar para que no la coloques, luego te des cuenta que esta al reves y ya no tengas termica. Despues de eso cumple muy bien con su funcion, relativamente facil de instalar, viene con todos los accesorios tanto para intel como para AMD por lo que podras montar como todo un pro. Mantiene la temperatura a raya asi que muy buena AIO. Me encantan sus luces RGB, son tan tenues y coquetas. Puedes controlar las luces por el board en mi caso MSI MAG B760 MORTAR WIFI II y funciona perfecto con la app mistic lights. Muy buena compra, recomendada
